# FreeRTOS Kernel

The source files in this directory are from FreeRTOS-Kernel V11.2.0,
commit `0adc196d4bd52a2d91102b525b0aafc1e14a2386`.
This copy contains the kernel headers, task scheduler, list implementation,
and Cortex-M7 r0p1 port. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md).

[Upstream revision](https://github.com/FreeRTOS/FreeRTOS-Kernel/tree/0adc196d4bd52a2d91102b525b0aafc1e14a2386)
